export function load(value: string): string;
export function load(value: number): number;
export function load(value: string | number) {
  function normalize() { return String(value); }
  const finish = function internal() { return normalize(); };
  return finish();
}

export class Store {
  constructor() { initialize(); }
  get value() { return read(); }
  set value(next: string) { write(next); }
  static open() { return new Store(); }
  save = async () => persist();
  update(value: string): void;
  update(value: string) { notify(value); }
}

const handlers = {
  onSave() { load("saved"); },
  onClose: () => close(),
};
const wrapped = (() => load("wrapped")) satisfies Callable;
const Box = class { render() { paint(); } };
items.map(() => load("callback"));
namespace Utilities { export function format() {} }
abstract class Base { abstract execute(): void; }
interface Shape { ignored(): void; }
type Callback = () => void;
